thread:
claire.design: Quick design checkor trace header: should Copy correlation id be primary instead of Export? current mock makes Export prominent. raj.product: Yes. Support teams copy ids all the time. Export is infrequent. morgan.pm: Metrics: copy ~3.8x export over last 30d. Data aligns. sam.eng: Note: large exports are async and can take a minute. If Export is secondary we should show queued state and not block. Backend can return job_id and status. claire.design: Proposed order (l->r): Copy chip | Export 1 (dropdown) | More. On small screens collapse Export into kebab menu. aria.a11y: A11y notes: the Copy chip must be keyboard-focusable, have an explicit aria-label with the full id, and update an aria-live region on success (aria-live="polite"). Ensure screen readers see the full id (no ellipsis). sam.eng: We'll add a hidden sr region:
and poll export status. For queued exports show toast "Export queued we'll email when ready". claire.design: Keyboard shortcut idea: when trace pane focused, press `c` to copy corr id. We'll flag in the shortcuts modal and add a small hint. aria.a11y: Fine as long as it doesn't conflict with existing app shortcuts and we document it in the help modal. Also ensure contrast for the Copy chip text meets 4.5:1 and focus ring is visible. morgan.pm: Add analytics events: trace.copy_corr_id, trace.export_requested (format, trace_size), trace.export_ready (file_size). claire.design: I'll iterate the mock and include SR copy snippets and microstates (idle, copying, queued, ready). Will post assets shortly. Thanks! :sparkles:
